test_title: PYST 31: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 28 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.

We need to upgrade to the late software to run this application.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the word "**late**" before the term "**software**."
 
• The correct word should be "**latest**" instead of "**late**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**to the latest software**," ensuring **grammatical correctness and clarity.**
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"We need to upgrade **to the latest software** to run this application."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1) No error –** This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 3.
 
• **2) We need to upgrade –** This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4) to run this application –** This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
